title: The orthogonal projection of an orthonormal frame has Gram determinant at most 1
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P) be a linear subspace with orthogonal projection q := V.starProjection : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, and let τ = (τ_1, …, τ_m) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P (Orthonormal ℝ τ). Let G be the m×m real Gram matrix of qτ_1, …, qτ_m, G_ij := ⟨qτ_i, qτ_j⟩ (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (V.starProjection (τ i)) (V.starProjection (τ j))). Then det G ≤ 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (τ : Fin m → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (V.starProjection (τ i)) (V.starProjection (τ j))) ≤ 1
